wikipedia.extract: Leucophaeus is a small genus of medium-sized New World gulls, most of which are dark in plumage, usually with white crescents above and below the eyes. They were placed in the genus Larus until recently.
wikipedia.title: Leucophaeus

wikipedia.extract: Wolf's mona monkey (Cercopithecus wolfi), also called Wolf's guenon, is a colourful Old World monkey in the family Cercopithecidae. It is found in central Africa, primarily between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
wikipedia.title: Wolf's mona monkey

wikipedia.extract: Bucerotiformes is an order of birds that contains the hornbills, ground hornbills, hoopoes and wood hoopoes. These birds were previously classified as members of Coraciiformes.
wikipedia.title: Bucerotiformes

wikipedia.extract: Amphibians are ectothermic, anamniotic, four-limbed vertebrate animals that constitute the class Amphibia. In its broadest sense, it is a paraphyletic group encompassing all tetrapods, but excluding the amniotes (tetrapods with an amniotic membrane, such as modern reptiles, birds and mammals).
wikipedia.title: Amphibian

wikipedia.extract: Tragopan is a bird genus in the pheasant family Phasianidae. Member of the genus are colloquially called "horned pheasants" because males have two brightly colored, fleshy horns on their head that can be erected during courtship displays, despite this name, they are not true pheasants and are not closely related to them.
wikipedia.title: Tragopan

commonNames.name: Thick-tailed Greater Galago
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The brown greater galago (Otolemur crassicaudatus), also known as the large-eared greater galago or thick-tailed galago, is a nocturnal primate, the largest in the family of galagos. As opposed to smaller galago species it would climb, walk or run rather than leap.
wikipedia.title: Brown greater galago

wikipedia.extract: Phoenicircus is a genus of birds in the family Cotingidae. They have a bright red breast, crown, tail, and rump with the Guianan species having dark brown wings and the black-necked species having black wings.
wikipedia.title: Phoenicircus

wikipedia.extract: Pseudobulweria is a genus of seabirds in the family Procellariidae. They have long been retained with the gadfly petrel genus Pterodroma despite morphological differences.
wikipedia.title: Pseudobulweria

wikipedia.extract: Described by French naturalist Anselme Gaëtan Desmarest in 1826, the genus Calyptorhynchus has two species of cockatoos. They are all mostly black in colour, and the taxa may be differentiated partly by size and partly by small areas of red, grey, and yellow plumage, especially in the tail feathers.
wikipedia.title: Calyptorhynchus

commonNames.name: SPIDER AND WOOLLY MONKEYS AND MURIQUIS

wikipedia.extract: The Atelidae are one of the five families of New World monkeys now recognised. It was formerly included in the family Cebidae.
wikipedia.title: Atelidae

wikipedia.extract: The Indriidae (formerly spelled Indridae) are a family of strepsirrhine primates. They are medium- to large-sized lemurs, with only four teeth in the toothcomb instead of the usual six.
wikipedia.title: Indriidae

wikipedia.extract: Esacus is a genus of bird in the stone-curlew family Burhinidae. The genus is distributed from Pakistan and India to Australia.
wikipedia.title: Esacus

commonNames.name: Betsileo Woolly Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Avahi betsileo Andriantompohavana, Lei, Zaonarivelo, Engberg, Nalanirina, McGuire, Shore et al., 2007

wikipedia.extract: The Betsileo woolly lemur or Betsileo avahi (Avahi betsileo) is a species of woolly lemur native to southeastern Madagascar, in the District of Fandriana. The pelage differs significantly from other southeastern woolly lemurs in that it is primarily light reddish brown on most of the body and grey under the jaw and on the extremities.
wikipedia.title: Betsileo woolly lemur

wikipedia.extract: Kuntur is an extinct monotypic genus of cathartid bird that lived in South America during the Tortonian stage of the Miocene epoch. Kuntur, the generic name, derives from the Quechua word for condor.
wikipedia.title: Kuntur

wikipedia.extract: Feducciavis is an extinct genus of sterninae that lived during the Middle Miocene.
wikipedia.title: Feducciavis
